scope.live_mutation: recreated graphiti-api with reviewed bind-mounted ingest patch; restarted graphiti-neo4j only after the graphiti-api restart exposed a stale Neo4j HTTP/Bolt response hang

remediation.upstream_bug: zepai/graphiti:0.30.2 /messages async worker accepted 202 but did not process queued episodes because the router lifespan did not start the worker and the queued closure captured a request-scoped Graphiti client that was closed after response.
remediation.deployed_fix: Bind-mounted a read-only tori-local ingest.py patch that processes /messages synchronously and adds /episodes for the reviewed curated ingest wrapper payload.
remediation.wrapper_fix: The agent wrapper now sends Graphiti-compatible search fields (group_ids/max_facts) and maps dotted policy group ids such as services.graphiti to upstream-safe ids such as services_graphiti. The human-facing policy group contract remains dotted.

verification.py_compile: services/graphiti Python files and tori ingest patch compile cleanly
verification.network_scope: ss confirmed listeners for 8000/7474/7687 are bound to 127.0.0.1 only
verification.mount_scope: docker inspect confirmed /opt/graphiti/patches/ingest.py is bind-mounted read-only into graphiti-api
verification.ingest_smoke: POST /episodes to disposable group services_graphiti_deploy_smoke returned success=true
verification.query_smoke: POST /search for the disposable group returned expected facts with episode UUID provenance
verification.cleanup: DELETE /group/services_graphiti_deploy_smoke returned success=true; destructive cleanup was limited to explicitly disposable test data

rollback: On tori: cd /opt/graphiti && docker compose stop graphiti-api
Restore the prior /opt/graphiti/docker-compose.yml from /opt/graphiti/backups/docker-compose.yml.<stamp> captured before this deployment, or remove the ingest.py bind mount from docker-compose.yml.
Remove or ignore /opt/graphiti/patches/ingest.py after compose rollback; it contains no secrets.
Run cd /opt/graphiti && docker compose up -d graphiti-api; verify curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthcheck and loopback-only listeners.

If Neo4j becomes unresponsive but the container is still marked healthy, restart only the graphiti-neo4j service and wait for health before starting graphiti-api. Preserve /var/lib/graphiti/neo4j/data unless a separately approved restore is underway.
downstream_notes: Production smoke/backup/restore evidence remains delegated to t_8a57f068.

The raw Graphiti API still contains DELETE and /clear endpoints inside the upstream app, but they are bound only to loopback and are not exposed through the agent wrapper; agents must use services/graphiti/scripts/graphiti-agent-wrapper.py.
